notes: Panel Settings now uses the real design system controls. The previous version used class names that are written throughout the app but are not actually styled anywhere, so every row rendered as raw unformatted text with its description…

Fixed the settings button on a panel doing nothing. Panels were never told which panel they are, so the button had no id to open. Each panel window now carries its own id, which is what the previous release assumed was already there.
Renaming a panel now reports failure instead of silently reverting, and refreshes the window when it succeeds.
The Panel Settings window sizes itself to its content rather than opening at a fixed height with empty space below the last setting.
